name: Star rating card over the speaker
description: A small white card near the top of the frame, over the speaker: a grey mono label on the left (e.g. RESULT) and five stars that fill in accent one by one up to the rating (half stars allowed; the rest stay light grey). An optional big white condensed quote word in curly quotes (e.g. “DECENT.”) then lands under the card with a soft shadow.
use_when: Lines that judge or grade something: an okay-ish result, a verdict, a review, 'it was fine', 'not great', 'five stars', a rating out of five.

label.help: grey mono label on the card

quote.help: optional one or two words shown big in curly quotes under the card, e.g. 'Decent.'
